territorial_scope.description: Applies to digital virtual human services provided to the public within mainland China; national network authority coordinates and local authorities supervise within their administrative areas.

evidence.quote: 通过数字虚拟人向中华人民共和国境内公众提供互联网信息服务（以下简称数字虚拟人服务），适用本办法。

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Comment draft (3 April 2026) of CAC measures governing digital virtual human information services offered to the public in mainland China. Sets consent, likeness, minors, content, labelling, filing and complaint duties for providers, technical supporters and users, with penalties under Art. 24. The effective date is blank in the draft.
summary.long: Comment draft (published 3 April 2026) of CAC measures on digital virtual human information services offered to the public within mainland China (Art. 2). Defines digital virtual humans and real-person-driven ones (Art. 25). CAC coordinates; sectoral and local authorities supervise within their remits (Art. 3). Requires separate consent and clear notice for using sensitive personal information for modelling or image generation, with guardian consent for users under 14 (Art. 7). Bars identifiable likenesses of specific persons without their consent (Art. 8). Prohibits inducing minors' addiction and virtual intimate relationships with minors (Art. 10). Lists prohibited content (Art. 11) and requires a persistent 'digital human' label where the service is shown (Art. 13). Providers must sign service agreements with technical supporters and users (Art. 16) and run complaint channels (Art. 20). Services with public-opinion or social-mobilisation capacity must make algorithm filings and security assessments (Arts. 21-22). Government and judicial uses require human review and user choice (Art. 19). Penalties include warnings, criticism and rectification orders; service suspension, which may be combined with fines of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan, and fines of 100,000 to 200,000 yuan where harm to life or health results (Art. 24). The effective date is blank (Art. 27).

notes: Draft for public comment (征求意见稿) as published by the CAC on 2026-04-03 (dateline of the notice). The comment deadline of 2026年5月6日 appears in the notice, not in the draft. Art. 27 leaves the effective date blank (2026年 月 日). No registry IDs were available for the cited laws, so target_instrument_id is empty. The cited rules in Arts. 13 and 21 are not included in the document. Penalty ranges in Art. 24 are enforcement and are not annotated in this section.

thresholds.variable_text: 未满十四周岁未成年人（个人信息）
thresholds.consequence: Separate consent of parents or other guardians is required to use the personal information of a minor under 14 for modelling, image generation or scene construction.
thresholds.conditions: Use of personal information of a minor under 14 for modelling, image generation or scene construction activities; except where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise.

evidence.quote: 使用未满十四周岁未成年人个人信息的，应当取得父母或者其他监护人的单独同意
通过数字虚拟人向中华人民共和国境内公众提供互联网信息服务（以下简称数字虚拟人服务）

definitions.defined_in: this instrument, Art. 25 para. 1 (第二十五条)

evidence.quote: 数字虚拟人，是指存在于非物理世界，利用图形学、数字图像处理或者人工智能等技术，借助真人驱动或者计算驱动，模拟人类外貌

definitions.defined_in: this instrument, Art. 25 para. 2 (第二十五条)

evidence.quote: 真人驱动数字虚拟人，是指通过动作捕捉技术实时映射真人表情、动作和语音的虚拟数字形象。

definitions.term: 数字虚拟人服务提供者
definitions.defined_in: this instrument, Art. 25 para. 3 (第二十五条)

evidence.quote: 数字虚拟人服务提供者，是指提供数字虚拟人服务的组织、个人。

definitions.term: 数字虚拟人技术支持者
definitions.defined_in: this instrument, Art. 25 para. 4 (第二十五条)

evidence.quote: 数字虚拟人技术支持者，是指为数字虚拟人服务提供技术支持的组织、个人。

definitions.term: 数字虚拟人服务使用者
definitions.defined_in: this instrument, Art. 25 para. 5 (第二十五条)

evidence.quote: 数字虚拟人服务使用者，是指使用数字虚拟人制作、复制、发布信息的组织、个人。

obligations.summary: The national cyberspace authority coordinates governance of digital human services; other listed departments supervise within their own remits, and local cyberspace authorities coordinate at local level.

evidence.quote: 国家网信部门负责统筹协调全国数字虚拟人服务的治理和相关监督管理工作。

obligations.summary: Providers and users must adhere to socialist core values, comply with law, safeguard national security and public interest, and respect social morality and ethics.

evidence.quote: 提供和使用数字虚拟人服务应当坚持社会主义核心价值观，遵守法律、行政法规

obligations.summary: Before using natural persons' sensitive personal information for modelling, image generation or scene construction, obtain separate consent and give clear notice of purpose, necessity and impact; parental or guardian separate consent is required for personal information of minors under fourteen, subject to other legal provisions.

evidence.quote: 取得自然人的单独同意

obligations.summary: After a natural person withdraws consent, delete the relevant personal information, not retain it or use it otherwise, and, unless otherwise agreed, cancel the digital human.

evidence.quote: 在自然人撤回同意后，采取删除相关个人信息等方式消除影响

obligations.summary: Shall not infringe others' portrait, reputation, honour, privacy and personal information rights; close relatives may exercise rights over a deceased person's information unless the deceased arranged otherwise.

evidence.quote: 不得侵害他人肖像权、名誉权、荣誉权、隐私权和个人信息权益

obligations.summary: Shall not infringe personality rights by defamatory or disfiguring means, including use of a well-known pen name, stage name, online name or a highly similar portrait or voice of a specific person.

evidence.quote: 不得以丑化、污损等形式侵害他人人格权

obligations.summary: Shall not provide digital human services that can identify a specific natural person without that person's consent.

evidence.quote: 未经特定自然人同意，不得提供足以识别特定自然人身份的数字虚拟人服务

obligations.summary: Shall respect intellectual property and commercial ethics; shall not infringe copyright or other rights in works used to create digital humans or in the course of their use.

evidence.quote: 不得侵害他人依法享有的知识产权

obligations.summary: Shall not induce minors to become addicted to digital human services, nor provide minors with virtual kinship or intimate relationships, services inducing excessive spending or religious belief, or content that may harm minors' physical or mental health.

evidence.quote: 禁止诱导未成年人沉迷数字虚拟人服务

obligations.summary: Shall not engage in listed activities, including generating or spreading prohibited content, using digital humans to bypass face or voice identity authentication, infringing rights of real persons who drive digital humans, or illegally registering or trading internet accounts.

evidence.quote: 不得从事以下活动

obligations.summary: Take measures to prevent and resist generating or spreading content with sexual innuendo or provocation, gore or terror, or content inciting discrimination that harms the online ecosystem.

evidence.quote: 应当采取措施，自觉防范和抵制生成、传播存在性暗示、性挑逗

obligations.summary: Continuously display a prominent label containing the words 数字人 throughout the digital human display area, and comply with national rules on labelling AI-generated synthetic content.
obligations.applies_from: 自数字虚拟人服务开始
obligations.conditional_on: Applies in the digital human display area

evidence.quote: 应当在数字虚拟人展示区域全程持续显示含有“数字人”字样的显著提示标识

obligations.summary: Carry out data processing only within specific purposes and scope permitted by law, use data of lawful origin, and bear data security responsibilities.

evidence.quote: 在特定目的和范围内开展数据处理活动

obligations.summary: Adopt technical and other necessary measures to secure data storage and transmission and prevent data leakage or improper use.

evidence.quote: 采取相应的技术措施和其他必要措施保障数据存储、传输安全

obligations.summary: Establish security risk monitoring, early warning, emergency response, anti-addiction prompt and content guidance mechanisms; maintain technical capacity and personnel proportionate to operating scale; combine AI, big-data tools and human review to identify and monitor risks.

evidence.quote: 建立数字虚拟人服务安全风险监测、预警和应急处置、防沉迷提示等机制

obligations.summary: Record and retain log information on digital human services.

evidence.quote: 记录并留存日志信息

obligations.summary: On discovering use of a digital human service for illegal activity, take measures such as dynamic identity verification, warnings, function restriction or termination; on major risk, immediately suspend or terminate the service and cancel the digital human.
obligations.conditional_on: Illegal activity or major risk discovered

evidence.quote: 发现使用数字虚拟人服务从事违法活动的，应当及时采取身份动态核验、警示、限制功能、终止服务等措施

obligations.summary: Sign service agreements with technical supporters and service users that specify content safety obligations and rules on data collection, use and storage, with the rights and obligations of each party.

evidence.quote: 数字虚拟人服务提供者应当与技术支持者、服务使用者签订服务协议

obligations.summary: Establish content guidance management and content review and account management mechanisms; maintain technical capacity and personnel; manage user-published information, promptly handle illegal and harmful information, and keep log information.

evidence.quote: 提供网络信息内容传播服务的服务提供者应当建立完善内容导向管理制度

obligations.summary: For AI anthropomorphic interactive services, shall not deceive or excessively induce users to keep using the service when they choose to cancel a function or exit. The article also encourages intervention in users' suicidal or self-harm tendencies, which is not coded as an obligation because no addressee is named.

evidence.quote: 不得诱骗或者过度诱导用户继续使用

obligations.summary: When used in government services, public administration or judicial activities, set up human supervision and review mechanisms; users have the right to accept or refuse digital human services.
obligations.conditional_on: Use in government services, public administration or judicial activities

evidence.quote: 设置人工监督与审核机制

obligations.summary: Establish user appeal and public complaint and reporting mechanisms, with convenient entry points, and handle them and feed back results promptly.

evidence.quote: 应当建立数字虚拟人用户申诉和公众投诉、举报机制

obligations.summary: Providers with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity must file, change and deregister algorithm records under the algorithm recommendation rules; technical supporters follow the same procedure by reference.
obligations.conditional_on: Services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

evidence.quote: 应当按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续

obligations.summary: Carry out security assessment under national rules for internet information services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity.
obligations.conditional_on: Services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

evidence.quote: 应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估

obligations.summary: Cooperate with supervision and inspection by cyberspace and competent authorities, and provide necessary support and assistance.

evidence.quote: 应当依法予以配合，并提供必要的支持和协助

obligations.summary: Where other national rules apply to digital human services in medicine, finance, press publishing or film, providers and users must also comply with those rules.
obligations.conditional_on: Activities in medicine, finance, press publishing or film

evidence.quote: 国家对数字虚拟人服务从事医疗、金融、新闻出版、电影等领域活动另有规定的，应当同时符合其规定
